content.title: MLB Opening Day Schedules
content.text: Without question, it is time to get excited! Opening Day of the 2026 Major League season is almost upon us. From Wednesday, March 25 to Friday, March 27, all teams will play their first game. With 30 teams in MLB, it might be difficult to know when exactly your favorite will take the field. No worries, however, as this MLB Opening Day Schedules edition has you covered!In this article, when and where each club plays on Opening Day will be established. For informational purposes, all times listed are Eastern. Further, if the pitching matchup is known, that will be included. Additionally, a few comments will be thrown in here and there. As always, reader’s inputs and questions are always welcome. With all of that said, let’s get to it!Update: As Opening Day starters are announced, I will revisit the article to include that information.Photo by Kathryn Skeean/MLB Photos via Getty ImagesWednesday, March 25New York Yankees at San Francisco Giants, 8:05 PM, Max Fried vs. Logan WebbComment: What a way to open the season! Two of the most iconic franchises in MLB history face off. Not only that, but two of the very best pitchers will take the hill. Whether you are a fan of either team, absolutely hate them, or are just a baseball fan, this is a must see game.Photo by Joe Robbins/Icon Sportswire via Getty ImagesThursday, March 26, Early After Noon GamesPittsburgh Pirates at New York Mets, 1:15 PM, Paul Skenes vs. Freddy PeraltaComment: Peralta makes his first start for the Mets after New York acquired him in an offseason trade with the Milwaukee Brewers. Of course, Skenes will take the ball for the Pirates, no surprise there.Chicago White Sox at Milwaukee Brewers, 2:10 PM, Shane Smith vs. Jacob MisiorowskiWashington Nationals at Chicago Cubs, 2:20 PM, Cade Cavalli vs. Matthew BoydMinnesota Twins at Baltimore Orioles, 3:05 PM, Joe Ryan vs. Trevor RogersPhoto by Houston Astros/Getty ImagesThursday, March 26 Late Afternoon GamesLos Angeles Angels at Houston Astros, 4:10 PM, Jose Soriano vs. Hunter BrownDetroit Tigers at San Diego Padres, 4:10 PM, Tarik Skubal vs. TBDComment: Skubal takes the mound for what might be his last Opening Day start for the Tigers. He will be a free agent following the season. Unfortunately, with the money that he is sure to get, this MLB Opening Day Schedules edition predicts that, indeed, when Skubal makes his next Opening Day start, it will be in a different uniform.Texas Rangers at Philadelphia Phillies, 4:15 PM, Nathan Eovaldi vs. Christopher SanchezTampa Bay Rays at St. Louis Cardinals, 4:15 PM, Drew Rasmussen vs. Matthew LiberatorePhoto by David Durochik/Diamond Images via Getty ImagesThursday, March 25 Evening GamesArizona Diamondbacks at Los Angeles Dodgers, 8:30 PM, Zac Gallen vs. Yoshinobu YamamotoComment: The Dodgers begin their quest for a third straight World Series championship. Meanwhile, much was expected from Arizona a year ago, but they fell well short. Can they bounce back? Going up against the defending champions is a good place to start.Cleveland Guardians at Seattle Mariners, 10:10 PM, Tanner Bibee vs. Logan GilbertPhoto by Julio Aguilar/Getty ImagesFriday, March 26 Opening Day GamesAthletics at Toronto Blue Jays, 7:07 PM, Louis Severino vs. Kevin GausmanComment: The Blue Jays begin defense of their American League Championship. Toronto made a splash in free agency with the signing of starting pitcher Dylan Cease. Even so, Gausman draws the Opening Day assignment for the Jays.Colorado Rockies at Miami Marlins, 7:10 PM, Kyle Freeland vs. Sandy AlcantaraKansas City Royals at Atlanta Braves, 7:15 PM, Cole Ragans vs. Chris SaleThe Final WordThank you for joining me for this MLB Opening Day Schedules edition! Follow me on X (formerly Twitter) @kevin62wilsea. Be sure to turn to bellyupsports.com for all the MLB, NBA, NFL, NHL happenings and the latest sports news!Featured Image Photo by New York Yankees/Getty Images
